thread:
ida: kicking off v2.10.0 canary in US-WEST (5%). saw a subtle spike in tokenization latency for long prompts.
sam: deploybot alert?
deploybot: ALERT: canary tokenization p95 +28% vs baseline (4m). Auto-rollback criteria: p95 >=30% OR error-rate >=0.5% sustained 5m. Current: p95 +28% (4m), errors 0.03%.
devex_kyle: we pushed the tokenizer micro-optimizations; curious why tail only on long prompts. Could be a path that falls back to legacy tokenizer.
ops-oncall: that's close to auto threshold and in a change window with paid customers on region. if this hits 30% auto-rollback will trigger and could disrupt reserved-pool routing. Recommend manual intervention: pin canary and run targeted repro.
ida: agree. Applying manual hold and disabling auto-increase. I'll record decision in the release notes thread.
deploybot: ACTION: canary hold applied by ida. Traffic frozen at 5%. Auto-rollback remains enabled.
sam: running quick smoke repro against long-prompts testset (est 8m). also pinging legal for any customer-facing wording constraints.
legal_jord: thanks for the heads-up. if we rollback we should avoid language that admits data exposure risk; keep it to "performance variance".
(8m later)
sam: smoke repro reproduced p95 +31% on long sequences (10m window). that's crossing auto threshold but we still have hold. ops, your call for rollback?
ops-oncall: given repro and reserved customers in the region, approve manual rollback for canary slice only. plan: rollback canary to 2.9.7, keep global traffic on 2.10.0 for non-reserved pools. Use graceful drain. I'll own comms with CS.
ida: executing `/deploy rollback --to 2.9.7 --region=us-west --slice=canary --graceful=true` now. pinging #customer-notify once complete.
deploybot: ROLLBACK STARTED by ida. Graceful drain initiated; estimate 3-5m to revert canary slice.
devex_kyle: will open a quick revert-pr for the tokenizer flags and add a unit test for the long-prompt path.
(4m later)
deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. Canary back on 2.9.7. Metrics: tokenization p95 back to baseline.
ops-oncall: sending customer-safe comms now per legal guidelines. CS notified. Creating INC-2142 and assigning postmortem to ida + devex_kyle.
ida: filing brief in the release thread and tagging kernel/tokenizer owners. We'll gate v2.10.0 for reserved pools until fix is validated.
sam: re-running extended repro and will post results in INC-2142.
devex_kyle: PR draft ready: revert micro-optimizations plus additional tests. CCing QA for canary regression job.
legal_jord: comms reviewed. good to send.
ops-oncall: closing hold. leaving auto-rollback config unchanged for future ramps but we tightened the canary rules to require 2 consecutive 5m windows before auto-rollback in change windows with reserved customers.
ida: thanks team. we'll reschedule the tokenizer change behind a dedicated canary and patch the release notes to call out the long-prompt caveat.
